scope: Prospective evidence contract only; sources unchanged, no computation, test, new physical/scientific result or remote issue action.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Actual electrical solar availability through day and night
entries.units: W/m2 projected; m2; W; s; location; orientation
entries.method: Request synchronized incident irradiance and net terminal solar power with projected geometry, orientation, shading, weather, location and calendar/time basis; identify electrical output separately from incident sunlight.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: A fixed day-average electrical input contains no instantaneous sunlight or weather schedule. Different projected area, orientation, shading or night interval invalidates transfer.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Storage charging, usable inventory and conversion losses
entries.existing_model_reference: CLASSES.battMWh/battMW; Question 9 storage and charging loss question
entries.units: V; A; W; Wh; state fraction; K; s
entries.method: Request synchronized battery/charger input and output, charge acceptance and usable state, thermal/health limits, idle losses and unavailable periods; retain net power at every shared bus boundary.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Nominal capacity and power ratings do not establish a usable charge window, charging efficiency or night buffering. Published energy quotients supply no buffering policy.

entries.existing_model_reference: energy-storage computeStorage hotelMW/netMW; record requirement excludes startup/cold maintenance
entries.method: Request time-aligned hotel, controls, cooling and cold-maintenance power, startup state and restart costs, with explicit system inclusions and metering boundaries.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: A fixed hotel allowance and omitted startup/cold-maintenance costs do not establish available net production power; unmatched inclusions invalidate comparison.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Actual liquefaction throughput and compatible duty cycle
entries.units: kg; kg/s; W; Wh/kg; K; Pa; s
entries.method: Request matched terminal energy, nitrogen purity/feed/product states and flow through startup, steady, turndown, shutdown and restart intervals; retain outages and simultaneous auxiliary loads.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Rated plant power and assumed specific energy do not establish minimum stable duty, readiness or production under intermittent solar; no energy or flow is computed here.

entries.existing_model_reference: energy-storage storageBalance fixed/proportional; plant-comparators storage; CLASSES.ln2CapT
entries.units: kg; kg/s; inventory fraction/time; K; Pa; s
entries.method: Request calibrated actual inventory, vent flow, thermal/pressure history and containment state over the same make interval; identify whether the denominator is installed capacity or current inventory.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Ground-tank comparators are not airborne loss properties. Fixed-capacity and inventory-proportional meanings differ; mismatched thermal/pressure/installation conditions or denominator invalidates transfer.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Matching initial state, target inventory and complete observation interval
entries.units: kg; m MSL; kg/m3; Pa; K; timestamp; s
entries.method: Request initial battery/cold/tank state, actual ground atmosphere and complete mass/inventory inclusion basis, target authority and synchronized histories for the entire candidate interval; preserve missing intervals and failure events.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Constant make, empty initial tank and target from the configured ground reference are stipulated model boundaries. A different initial state, ground atmosphere, ballast criterion or missing interval prevents transfer; no duration is predicted.
